changelog: Lead page interaction filter and stage history (#3820): the sales lead page's interaction list gains an "All · Interactions · System" segmented filter (default All, remembered per browser) and shows the record's stage moves, read from the existing `StatusChange` rows, as one-line system entries next to the follow-up history (#3819).

en: The lead page shows stage changes in the interaction list, and a filter switches between all entries, interactions only and system lines.
tr: Lead sayfası aşama değişikliklerini etkileşim listesinde gösteriyor; bir filtreyle tüm kayıtlar, yalnızca görüşmeler ve sistem satırları arasında geçilebiliyor.
de: Die Lead-Seite zeigt Phasenwechsel in der Interaktionsliste, und ein Filter wechselt zwischen allen Einträgen, nur Interaktionen und Systemzeilen.
